## Definition and typical features 
These studies aim to describe the use of methods in practice, often with an intention to highlight good or poor practice.

## Boundaries to related purposes

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples 
[Quantitative survey](../approaches/6survey.qmd): assess current practice of involving patients in statistical research.[@Abell2023incorporation]

[Qualitative study](../approaches/7qualitative-study.qmd): Interviews to understand the reasons for non-reporting of outcomes.[@Smyth2011frequency]

[Review of applied methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): types of initial data analysis in observational studies;[@Huebner2020hidden] quality and reporting of prediction models for COVID-19.[@Wynants2020prediction]
